name: Wick
examine: The younger twin. Collects facts about the Waking Ring. All of them are wrong. All of them are delivered with total confidence.
lines: The stones hum if you press your ear on them. Tansy says that's my own blood. Tansy is wrong.
Did you have a horse before? You have a walking-about look. I bet you had a horse.
There were SIX stones once. The sixth one left. That's what I think happened.
